summary.summary: During this session, you spent a total of KES 300, which was used for tea under the food category. Tracking daily small expenses like tea runs is a great step toward managing your money. Staying consistent will help you see exactly where your shillings go each month.
ways_to_save: Consider making tea at home and carrying it in a flask to save on daily buying costs.
Buy tea leaves and sugar in bulk from a local supermarket or wholesale shop to lower per-cup expenses.
Set a dedicated weekly M-Pesa budget for snacks and drinks to avoid overspending on small daily purchases.
